# NutriSen

> NutriSen GmbH, based in Straubing, Germany, develops electrochemical biosensors. In agriculture, a biosensor that measures nitrate in plant juice directly in the field and a fertilisation platform help farmers fertilise by need. The same biosensor platform is being developed for medical devices. The website is available in English and German.

## Company
- [NutriSen at a glance: facts, team and products](https://www.nutrisen.eu/nutrisen-at-a-glance/): Key facts about NutriSen GmbH: nitrate biosensor for farmers, medical biosensor platform, team, research funding, awards and contact.
- [About NutriSen: from the lab to the field](https://www.nutrisen.eu/agriculture/from-lab-to-field/): In the laboratory we developed the first enzymatic-based sensor for measuring plant nutrients, directly in the field.

## Agriculture
- [Fertilize by need: nitrate sensing for farmers](https://www.nutrisen.eu/agriculture/): Real-time nutrient sensing for smart fertilization: up to 30% less fertilizer and savings of up to 90 EUR per ha are possible. Calculate your own savings.
- [How it works: nitrate test strips for your field](https://www.nutrisen.eu/agriculture/how-does-it-work/): We developed the first biosensor test strips that can precisely measure the amount of nitrate, phosphate and potassium in plants, directly on the field.
- [Practice cases 2025/2026: less fertilizer](https://www.nutrisen.eu/agriculture/use-cases/): Five practice cases 2025/2026: up to 30 % less fertilizer at the same yield, in individual cases also a higher yield.
- [NutriSen fertilizer calculator: compare 3 applications](https://www.nutrisen.eu/agriculture/calculator/): Compare your usual fertilization with NutriSen in three applications, with fertilizer price suggestions from official EU data.
- [Free nitrate test for your field in Bayern](https://www.nutrisen.eu/agriculture/test-your-field/): Do you wonder every year when and how much fertilizer to apply to the field? We are looking for innovators who want to test a new technology for free.

## Medical
- [Biosensors for digital health](https://www.nutrisen.eu/medical/): Biosensors for lactate, creatinine and more: direct molecular sensing for medical-device makers and digital health. Get in touch with NutriSen.

## Articles
- [Blog: fertilizer prices, plant nutrition, nitrate](https://www.nutrisen.eu/blog/): Articles about fertiliser prices, plant nutrition and nitrogen management from NutriSen.
- [Nutrient prices: why the EU reports them](https://www.nutrisen.eu/blog/nutrient-prices-eu-reporting/): Fertiliser prices swing with gas, trade and politics. Why the EU tracks them, what the numbers really mean, and how to use them for your own planning.
- [JUBIL® stem-juice nitrate test explained](https://www.nutrisen.eu/blog/jubil-nitrate-method/): Where the JUBIL® stem-juice nitrate test comes from, how it steers the last nitrogen application in winter wheat, and why it works.
- [Wheat nitrogen by BBCH stage: Germany vs France](https://www.nutrisen.eu/blog/bbch-winter-wheat-germany-france/): How the BBCH scale guides nitrogen in winter wheat, how Germany and France split the doses, and where the JUBIL® stem-juice nitrate test fits in.
- [DWD Bright Sky API: free weather data for farmers](https://www.nutrisen.eu/blog/dwd-bright-sky-api-farmers/): Bright Sky offers the open weather data of the German weather service as a free API. How farmers can use it for spraying, spreading and crop monitoring.
- [Science Advances: oxygen scavenger for biosensors](https://www.nutrisen.eu/blog/oxygen-scavenger-science-advances/): New paper in Science Advances: an enzymatic oxygen scavenger lifts the accuracy of oxidase-based biosensors for glucose, lactate and creatinine to 99%.
